symptoms: typical: Feathery purple patterns on leaves severe_strains: root necrosis leaf chlorosis root discoloration co-infections: SPVD: Occurs when SPFMV co-infects with SPCSV; causes stunted growth, severe mosaic, leaf distortion, reduced yield synergism_effects: SPFMV titers up to 600x higher in SPVD; enhanced spread and replication
management: early_detection: ELISA for virus identification removal: Remove infected plants to prevent spread prevention: Plant virus-free propagation material Properly clean tools to prevent mechanical transmission Use transgenic plants expressing antiviral genes
sources: Various sources from plant virology and sweet potato disease studies as cited in user-provided content
